name: Virginia Quiet Championship 2026
information:
This is the Virginia Quiet Championship, but anyone can compete regardless of their state of residence. See more information on the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VirginiaQuietChampionship2026#76809-championship-eligibility).

This competition only has blind events and Fewest Moves, therefore, we do not recommend it for new competitors. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in Virginia](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=Virginia&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list); Such as [Virginia Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VirginiaChampionship2026).

This competition will take place in the Theater. Please see parking information as well as other venue information on the [Venue Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VirginiaQuietChampionship2026#76803-travel-venue) tab.
